before.bootcmd: if fatload mmc 1:2 0x52000000 h713-hdmi.scr; then source 0x52000000; else echo HDMI startup script missing - use h713_hdmi_previous_bootcmd for recovery; fi

final.bootcmd: if fatload mmc 1:2 0x52000000 h713-hdmi.scr; then source 0x52000000; else echo HDMI startup script missing - use h713_hdmi_previous_bootcmd for recovery; fi

bootargs: console=ttyS0,115200 console=tty0 earlycon root=/dev/mmcblk0p26 rootwait rootfstype=ext4 rw net.ifnames=0 panic=0 clk_ignore_unused pd_ignore_unused cma=128M h713_tvfe_trace=1 loglevel=7 h713_tvfe_retain=1
